summary: Live engine gauges on the iDrive 6 screen: boost, AFR, timing and more
author: inotbarnacle (packaged by NBTApps)
description:
A page of live engine gauges under My Vehicle, read from the car's own control units.

What it does
- Boost, AFR, ignition timing, intake air temperature, transmission temperature, rail pressure, oil pressure, coolant temperature and Active Ethanol
- OPTIONS changes the gauge colour, Multicolor among them, and switches between PSI with Fahrenheit and bar with Celsius
- The colour and the units are kept across restarts of iDrive, and go when the package is removed

What you need
- An NBT Evo head unit with iDrive 6 (ID6), on a software version the app was built for (see Good to know)
- NBTApps agent 1.6.0 or later
- The car's diagnostic gateway at 169.254.21.3, which is where the app looks for it

After installing
The iDrive screen restarts. Open My Vehicle and choose BoostDeck.

Good to know
- The readings are set up for the first-generation B58 engine; the author's car is a 340i. On another engine some of them may stay blank
- The page is laid out for the screen when the package is installed: 800×480, 960×480, 1280×480 or 1920×720. On a 1440×540 screen the 1280×480 layout is used, because the author's 1440×540 layout is reported to be cut off at the right edge. If the screen's size cannot be read, the 1280×480 layout is used too
- On NBTevo_R19144I, owners report that the iDrive screen freezes with BoostDeck and ShiftDeck
- Owners report that on some cars the app only gets data while a device is plugged into the OBD port
- This package does not check the head unit's software version. The author's own installer accepts only these NBTevo versions: L17252I, M17365I, N18032I, N18092I, P18362I, Q18491I, R19144I, S19322I, T18501I, U19384I, V20153I, X20511I, Y21432J, Y22292I, Y23236I and Y24073J. On another version the menu may not load
- If the app was put on this car before, with the author's desktop installer or by hand, uninstall it the same way first. NBTApps refuses to install over it
- A car whose diagnostic gateway has another address needs a gateway-ip.txt file in the app's folder on the head unit. This package does not write one
- This is a pre-release: the package has not yet been installed on a car through NBTApps

BoostDeck is by inotbarnacle, free of charge under the MIT License. NBTApps packages the author's own builds, unchanged, with the author's agreement. It comes as it is: you install it at your own risk.
